# IIK Bhakta - Institut Ilmu Kesehatan Bhakti Wiyata Kediri

> Institut kesehatan pertama di Indonesia yang diakui MURI dan terlengkap dengan 25 program studi di 5 fakultas. Terakreditasi Unggul oleh LAM PT-Kes.

## Core Information
- **Location:** Jl. KH. Wahid Hasyim No. 65, Kediri, Jawa Timur.
- **Accreditation:** Unggul (LAM PT-Kes), SNI Award winner.
- **Rank:** 2nd Best Private Institute in East Java (LLDIKTI7).
- **History:** Established in 2005, with over 17,500 alumni.

## Academic Programs (25 Programs across 5 Faculties)
- **Fakultas Kesehatan:** S1 Keperawatan, S1 Kebidanan, S1 Gizi, S1 Fisioterapi, S1 Psikologi, D4 TCM, D3 Fisioterapi, D3 Kebidanan, Profesi Ners & Bidan.
- **Fakultas Kedokteran:** S1 Kedokteran, Profesi Dokter (First in Kediri region).
- **Fakultas Farmasi:** Pendidikan Profesi Apoteker, S1 Farmasi, D3 Farmasi, D3 Analisis Farmasi & Makanan.
- **Fakultas Kedokteran Gigi:** S1 Kedokteran Gigi, D3 Teknik Gigi, Profesi Dokter Gigi.
- **Fakultas Teknologi & Manajemen Kesehatan:** S1 Kesmas, S1 Ars, D4 TLM, D3 TLM, D3 RMIK, S2 Kesmas.

## Admissions (PMB)
- **Methods:** - Online: www.pmb.iik.ac.id
    - Offline: Admissions Office (Jl. KH. Wachid Hasyim 65, Kediri).
- **Special Programs:** - RPL (Rekognisi Pembelajaran Lampau)
    - Progsus (For working SMK graduates)
    - Alih Jenjang (D3 to S1)
- **Selection Process:** 1. Registration -> 2. Admin Check -> 3. Written Test -> 4. Health Test -> 5. Enrollment.

## Scholarships & Costs
- **Scholarships:** Beasiswa Unggul Bhakti (Academic), Beasiswa Peduli Pendidikan (Financial Aid).
- **Living Cost in Kediri:** Very affordable.
    - Housing: Rp500k - Rp1.000k/month.
    - Meals: ~Rp25k/day.
- **Official Dormitory:** KOSy (www.kosy.co.id).

## Vision & Mission
- **Vision:** To become a leading Health Higher Education Institution in ASEAN.
- **Mission:** 
  1. Quality & innovative health education based on advanced technology.
  2. Innovative health research oriented towards advanced technology utilization.
  3. Integrative and sustainable community service.
  4. Professional and accountable governance based on PLUS culture (Prima, Luhur, Unggul, Sejahtera).

## Support Facilities
- **Facilities Count:** Over 63 laboratories across all faculties.
- **Academic:** Adipadma Library (modern), RSGM (Dental & Oral Hospital), Mini Hospital, Dental Simulator, Apotek Bhakta (Pharmacy).
- **Campus Life:** Graha Bhakta Hall, Adipadma Sport Hall, Fitness Center, Bhakta Shop, Podcast Studio, AV Theater, and Food Court.

## Student Life & Organizations
- **Governance:** DPM (Student Council), BEM (Executive Body), HIMA (Program level).
- **Activities (UKM):**
  - **Sports:** Futsal, Volleyball, Basketball, Badminton.
  - **Arts:** Choir (Padus), Dance, Music.
  - **Skills:** English Club, Journalism, Entrepreneurship, Scientific Writing (FIKTI).
  - **Social:** KSR (Volunteers), PIK-M Garuda Bhakti.

## Partnerships & Collaborations
- **International:** Partners in Malaysia (Lincoln, MSU, MAHSA), South Korea (Daegu Health College), China (Yunnan, Baoshan), and Russia (Tomsk, RUDN).
- **National:** Collaborations with BKKBN, BNN, BPJS, and various regional hospitals/health clinics.

## Contact & Access
- **WhatsApp:** 0857 1717 1735
- **Transport:** 5 minutes from Kediri Train Station or Tamanan Bus Terminal.
- **Official Website:** www.iik.ac.id
